mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, group_id, policy_id, claim_reference, claim_status, claim_amount, service_date, filing_date, provider_name, diagnosis_code, description, created_at, updated_at FROM claims WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND group_id = #{groupId} AND service_date >= #{startDate} AND service_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY service_date DESC LIMIT 10
